description: Protect the item's public address with a password (12 to 128 characters) and return that address. Anyone who opens it gets a password form (browsers) or can send the password in an x-password header (agents); each successful open counts one read. Replaces any previous password. Signed share_link URLs are not affected. Free.

secret.description: The item's secret (sk_...), returned once by store.

name: set_password
